titleEn: Store MCP for shopping agents (search, cart, order status)
mcpTool: get_store_info; search_products; get_product; view_cart; add_to_cart; place_order; get_order_status

ar: هل AI agent يقدر يشتري من متجري؟
en: Can AI agents buy from my store?

steps: Enabled by feature; X-Agent-Key required for writes.
edgeCases: Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
